findings.proposed: La mise à jour du serveur nécessite environ {needed, number, ::group-off} Mo d’espace libre sur ce disque, et il n’y en a que {free, number, ::group-off} Mo\u202f; l’application a donc laissé intact l’environnement qui sert cette application. Libérez de l’espace, puis réessayez.
findings.reason: The NNBSP pass replaced the ASCII space inside the ICU arguments `{needed, number,<U+202F>::group-off}` and `{free, number,<U+202F>::group-off}`; U+202F is not ICU pattern whitespace, so the `::group-off` skeleton is not recognised and the numbers render grouped. Rendered: EN `needed=1500, free=12345` -> `about 1500 MB … 12345 MB`; current fr -> `environ 1 500 Mo … 12 345 Mo`; with the ASCII space restored -> `environ 1500 Mo … 12345 Mo`. The technical token `::group-off` must survive verbatim; locale-parity does not catch it (it compares placeholder names only). Fix: keep U+0020 inside `{…}` and keep NNBSP only before the prose `;`/`:`.
